description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ItemNotFoundException' used within the order shopping cart module of the OFBiz framework. It extends the 'GeneralException' class and provides multiple constructors for different use cases.

classes.name: ItemNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception thrown when a particular item cannot be found in the shopping cart.

methods.name: ItemNotFoundException(Throwable nested)
methods.description: Constructor accepting a nested Throwable cause.

methods.name: ItemNotFoundException(String str, Throwable nested)
methods.description: Constructor accepting both a message string and a nested Throwable cause.
